## History

John Selwyn emigrated from the Old Country as a young man to teach school at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), where he boarded at Captain Jim's father's house. He was subject to periodic trances, a trait he shared with a great-great-grandmother who had been burned as a witch, and which he viewed as either a gift or a curse. During his time at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), he became the first husband of the bride who lived in the house later occupied by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Decades later, his grandson [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) traveled to the region, drawn by his connection to John Selwyn.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P8](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0008), +57 more_

## Relationships

### [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-selwyn--persis-leigh.md)

John Selwyn and [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md) share a historic romantic connection as sweethearts who ultimately got married. Their wedding took place at Captain Jim's house at early candle-lighting, an event remembered and retold by Captain Jim years later as the story of the home's first bride and her schoolmaster husband.

- Romantically involved with — sweetheart  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P7](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0007)</sub>
